skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my music track into a YouTube video with a visualizer and track title...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Music to YouTube" skill for converting music tracks to YouTube-ready videos.
- Easily upload audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC up to 500MB) and receive a video with a visualizer and track title overlay in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic backend handling: authentication, session management, and cloud GPU video rendering—no editing software required.
- Supports prompts for export, credits, upload, and status checks with user-friendly responses.
- Handles errors gracefully, offering clear instructions and credit management.
- Designed for musicians and producers seeking fast, professional video exports for YouTube without technical barriers.
